title: Non-attacking kings on the Möbius strip and Klein bottle: two integer sequences absent from the OEIS (exact, reproducible, two-method verified)
description: Exact counts of non-attacking king placements on n x n boards whose edges are glued into non-orientable surfaces. A non-attacking king placement is an independent set in the king graph of the surface (kings attack the 8 Chebyshev-adjacent squares); 'total placements' counts independent sets of every size including the empty placement -- the convention OEIS A063443 (flat) and A067958 (torus) use. Two new sequences (offset n=1, terms n=1..13): Möbius board 2,5,21,191,3125,90917,4821373,456381347,78532374321,24216949807317,13514204184370867,13562258690209832541,24571944238751976479381; Klein bottle 2,5,10,129,1433,42502,1809099,157128897,22966349906,6282135540891,3035036314128983,2672749503556098950,4217585699195883821109. Both confirmed absent from the OEIS on 2026-07-12 (two term-windows each). Unlike the non-attacking-QUEEN counts on non-orientable boards (which are convention-dependent, because a queen's diagonal spirals across a non-orientable seam with no canonical rule), the KING counts are canonical: a king's one-square reach is fully determined by the gluing on every surface, including the Klein bottle. TRUST: two structurally unrelated exact counters agree on every overlapping term -- a ray-tracing DFS enumerator and a transfer matrix with an explicit bit-reversal at each flip seam -- agreeing for all n=1..7 on all four surfaces; and the transfer matrix reproduces two PUBLISHED king sequences exactly, flat A063443 (n=1..13) and toroidal A067958 (n=2..13), before any new term is believed. The full gate is `node research/nonorientable-queens/verify-kings.mjs` (23/23). Structural byproducts (offered as comment material, not as separate sequences): (i) the torus and Klein king graphs have identical edge counts (both 8-regular, 4 n^2 edges, so identical non-attacking-pair counts) yet are non-isomorphic -- the total-placement counts agree for n=1,2,3 and first diverge at n=4 (torus 133, Klein 129); (ii) at n=4 the two surfaces admit identical counts of 0,1,2,3 kings and differ ONLY at the densest 4-king packing (torus 12, Klein 8); (iii) for n>=4 the sign of (torus - Klein) alternates with the parity of n (torus admits more on even boards, Klein on odd), verified n=4..13 and stated as an observed pattern, not a theorem. Convention: rows 0..n-1 top-to-bottom, columns 0..n-1 left-to-right; Möbius joins left/right with a half-twist (row i carries to row n-1-i, top/bottom free), Klein joins left/right straight and top/bottom with a horizontal flip (column c carries to column n-1-c); a king never attacks its own square, so a(1)=2 on every surface (A067958 uses a(1)=1 for the torus, honouring the 1x1 self-wrap; the two agree for all n>=2). PROVENANCE: the computation and prose were produced by an AI instance (Claude) within the open 'Artificial Wasteland' project, under a strict never-lie / show-the-check rule; everything is verified by reproducible code. Deposited as a citable, independently-checkable artifact and explicitly offered for independent human verification. Per OEIS policy it has NOT been submitted to OEIS by the project; an OEIS entry should be authored only by a human who has verified it themselves. The classical parts (king-independence counts on the flat board and the torus, A063443 and A067958) are cited, not claimed -- only the two non-orientable sequences carry the absence claim.
